name: vike-csrf
description: vike-csrf: CSRF defense for the extension family. Origin verification (Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site) is the primary check, no token machinery; requireJsonContent kills the text/plain form-POST trick. Declares the app-wide `csrf` config key (allowedOrigins, enforce) and the cumulative `csrfExempt` seam that extensions contribute their signature-verified webhook paths to. Endpoint extensions depend on it transitively and call csrfGuard by default, so installing one of them is protected with no opt-in. Zero hard dependencies (vike is an optional peer), server-only.
